title: 01 Moscow 13169: UFOs Over Georgia: Strange Encounters of an MFA Kind
doc_notes: This document is a diplomatic cable from the U.S. Embassy in Moscow regarding alleged airspace violations in Georgia, where the term 'UFO' is used dismissively by a Russian official to characterize unidentified aerial activity.

incidents.summary: Alleged violation of Georgian airspace and bombing of the Kodori Gorge by unidentified aircraft.
incidents.explanation: Russian officials denied involvement and suggested reports of planes might be 'UFOs' or potentially other unidentified aircraft.
incidents.quote: REPORTS OF PLANES IN THE AREA MIGHT AS WELL HAVE BEEN ABOUT UFOS
